dedupe_keys.name: ribuild outdoor test stand with solid wall in combination with wooden beam ends at dtu

description: N.F. Jensen and colleagues at the Technical University of Denmark publish measurements and simulation material for an outdoor wall test stand with embedded timber beam ends. The experiment compares internal-insulation systems and surface treatments under outdoor exposure, including wind-driven rain. The bundle combines measurements, fungal-growth risk predictions, Mycometer and pH tests, photographs, DELPHIN 6 models and associated simulation results. Zenodo lists 38 archive, spreadsheet and document files, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. These components support hygrothermal testing and model validation of building-envelope retrofits. A limitation is that the descriptive metadata does not establish a complete temporal coverage or sampling interval. The source explicitly distinguishes related indoor hotbox/coldbox experiments at KU Leuven and TU Dresden. The RIBuild failure-model collection also uses a WP3 setup; independence of all measurements is not claimed. The related historic-building survey provides broader project context.
